# i18n - translation lookup, CLDR plural rules, the {n} formatter and UTF-8 helpers
# (docs/features/37). Portable C11. catalogs/i18n_catalogs_gen.c is generated by
# tools/i18n.py build.
set(I18N_SRCS
    src/i18n.c
    src/i18n_plural.c
    src/i18n_format.c
    src/i18n_utf8.c
    src/i18n_region.c
    src/i18n_date.c
    src/i18n_pack.c
)
# Every catalog tools/i18n.py build generated (i18n_catalogs_gen.c and one file per language). A
# new catalog needs a reconfigure, like any new file.
file(GLOB I18N_CATALOG_SRCS RELATIVE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} catalogs/*_gen.c)
# A PC build may take other catalogs instead (the test languages en-XA and ar-XB, which
# tools/i18n.py pseudo --build writes to build/i18n/pseudo; docs/features/37 I18N-024).
if(NOT ESP_PLATFORM AND I18N_CATALOG_DIR)
    file(GLOB I18N_CATALOG_SRCS ${I18N_CATALOG_DIR}/*_gen.c)
endif()
# The template fingerprint (i18n_template_gen.c, the same file whatever catalogs are chosen) is
# compiled exactly once in every build: leave the glob's copy out and add it by name.
list(FILTER I18N_CATALOG_SRCS EXCLUDE REGEX "i18n_template_gen\\.c$")
list(APPEND I18N_SRCS ${I18N_CATALOG_SRCS} catalogs/i18n_template_gen.c)

if(ESP_PLATFORM)
    idf_component_register(SRCS ${I18N_SRCS}
                           INCLUDE_DIRS include
                           PRIV_INCLUDE_DIRS src)
else()
    add_library(i18n STATIC ${I18N_SRCS})
    target_include_directories(i18n PUBLIC include PRIVATE src)
    target_compile_features(i18n PUBLIC c_std_11)
    set_target_properties(i18n PROPERTIES C_EXTENSIONS OFF)
endif()
